scope: Targeted Phase 5 extraction from the official Theros Beyond Death Story Summary (Wizards of the Coast, 2020-01-10), told in third-person narration. PRELIMINARY_RESEARCH; not owner approved.

claims.subject: theros_gods

quotes.quote: Imbued with incredible power by the faith of mortals, the gods sealed the titans away in the Underworld.

claims.summary: The gods of Theros sealed the titans away in the Underworld.

claims.subject: klothys

quotes.quote: Klothys, the god of fate, volunteered to act as jailer and sequestered herself in the Underworld for eternity.
it was Klothys who acted as eternal seal, ensuring the titans remained trapped

claims.summary: Klothys acts as jailer and eternal seal keeping the titans trapped.

claims.subject: erebos

quotes.quote: While Erebos rules this realm beyond death

claims.summary: Erebos rules the Underworld of Theros.

claims.subject: elspeth_tirel

quotes.quote: The sun god Heliod sent his champion, the Planeswalker Elspeth, to destroy Xenagos—and she succeeded.

claims.summary: As Heliod's champion, Elspeth destroyed the ascended god Xenagos.

claims.subject: heliod

quotes.quote: Fearful, Heliod struck Elspeth down in her moment of triumph, casting her into the Underworld to be forgotten.

claims.summary: Heliod killed Elspeth after her victory and cast her into the Underworld.

claims.subject: elspeth_tirel

quotes.quote: Of Daxos, her former love, whom she was tricked into killing.

claims.summary: Daxos was Elspeth's former love.

claims.subject: daxos

quotes.quote: To that end, he pulled the soul of the oracle Daxos and transformed him into his champion in the mortal realm.

claims.summary: Heliod transformed the oracle Daxos into his demigod champion.

claims.subject: klothys

quotes.quote: So Klothys weaved her masterpiece—an agent of fate she called Calix.

claims.summary: Klothys created Calix as an agent of fate.

claims.subject: elspeth_tirel

quotes.quote: She also clashed repeatedly with Calix, emerging victorious every time.
Still, she defeated him one final time as she reached the exit.

claims.summary: Elspeth repeatedly defeated Calix during her escape.

claims.subject: elspeth_tirel

quotes.quote: Staring down the point of a spear that was no longer his, Heliod yielded.

claims.summary: Heliod yielded to Elspeth when his spear shattered.

claims.subject: erebos

quotes.quote: And Erebos simply took the defeated sun god and placed him beneath a giant boulder

claims.summary: Erebos imprisoned the defeated Heliod beneath a giant boulder.

claims.subject: calix

quotes.quote: Calix headed off in pursuit of Elspeth in order to preserve that which should be.
But in his darkest hour, a strange idea sparked within him—and he simply planeswalked after her.

claims.summary: Calix pursued Elspeth, ultimately planeswalking after her.

claims.subject: ashiok

quotes.quote: Ashiok's visions are more real than most, and in one of them, Elspeth seized Heliod's spear Khrusor.
When the vision had passed, a twisted version of the spear remained, dripping with darkness and power.

claims.summary: The shadowspear came out of one of Ashiok's nightmare visions.
claims.limitation: The summary says the spear remained after Ashiok's vision; calling Ashiok its creator is an inference.

claims.subject: ashiok

quotes.quote: Ashiok learned of the Phyrexians' existence and promptly planeswalked away to learn more of these true living nightmares.

claims.summary: Ashiok left Theros to learn more about the Phyrexians.

claims.subject: purphoros

quotes.quote: To fight the sun god Heliod, the forge god Purphoros created a sword capable of damaging the divine.
The two gods battled, disrupting the celestial resting place of an ancient and powerful hydra: Polukranos, World Eater.

claims.summary: Purphoros forged a god-harming sword and battled Heliod.

claims.subject: heliod

quotes.quote: Enraged, the hydra stormed through the mortal realm of Theros until it was sealed by Heliod and the hunt god Nylea.

claims.summary: Heliod and Nylea sealed Polukranos after it rampaged.

claims.subject: nylea

quotes.quote: Enraged, the hydra stormed through the mortal realm of Theros until it was sealed by Heliod and the hunt god Nylea.

claims.summary: Nylea helped Heliod seal Polukranos.

claims.subject: heliod

quotes.quote: so he reforged the sword into the spear Godsend.
He transforms her sword into a spear, which becomes known as Godsend.

claims.summary: Heliod reforged Purphoros's sword into the spear Godsend.

claims.subject: elspeth_tirel

quotes.quote: She journeyed to Nyx and stabbed Xenagos with Godsend, destroying him once and for all.
Elspeth struggles to kill Xenagos until she pinpoints the last vestige of the satyr's mortality and strikes him down with her god-forged weapon.

claims.summary: Elspeth destroyed the god Xenagos in Nyx with Godsend.

claims.subject: heliod

quotes.quote: Fearful of her power and knowledge of the multiverse, Heliod stabbed Elspeth with her very own weapon, which shattered afterwards.
leaving a mortally wounded Elspeth to die alone near the Temple of the Gods.

claims.summary: Heliod struck Elspeth down with her own spear; she died and her soul went to the Underworld.
claims.limitation: She later escapes the Underworld (Theros Beyond Death).

claims.subject: xenagos

quotes.quote: Using magic, he manipulates her into killing Daxos on the night of the Great Revel.

claims.summary: Xenagos magically manipulated Elspeth into killing Daxos during the Great Revel.

claims.subject: elspeth_tirel

quotes.quote: Using magic, he manipulates her into killing Daxos on the night of the Great Revel.
she vows to stay until she avenges Daxos's death and destroys Xenagos.

claims.summary: Elspeth killed Daxos during the Great Revel.
claims.limitation: She acted under Xenagos's magical manipulation.

claims.subject: daxos

quotes.quote: Daxos, an oracle of Heliod, becomes her friend and mentor.

claims.summary: Daxos, an oracle of Heliod, became Elspeth's friend and mentor in Meletis.

claims.subject: kruphix

quotes.quote: Kruphix is forced to enact the Silence, which draws the gods back to Nyx and leaves the mortals to temporarily fend for themselves.

claims.summary: Kruphix enacted the Silence, drawing the gods back to Nyx.

claims.subject: ajani

quotes.quote: Her friend, Ajani, finds her in the wilderness and offers to help.

claims.summary: Ajani found Elspeth in the wilderness and helped her.

claims.subject: kiora

quotes.quote: With the help of a mysterious merfolk who turns out to be Kiora, Ajani and Elspeth make their way across the sea to Kruphix's temple at the waterfall at the edge of the world.

claims.summary: Kiora helped Ajani and Elspeth cross the sea to Kruphix's temple.

claims.subject: xenagos

quotes.quote: he was able to transcend mortality and join the other gods in their home of Nyx.

claims.summary: Xenagos ascended and joined the gods in Nyx.
claims.limitation: He was later destroyed by Elspeth (TB019).

claims.subject: klothys

quotes.quote: The idea of having Klothys trapped in the Underworld thematically fit the set and explained the absence in the previous block.

claims.summary: Klothys is trapped in the Underworld, which explains her absence from the original Theros block.
claims.limitation: Design commentary (Making Magic mailbag), not narrative fiction.

claims.subject: theros_titans

quotes.quote: Yes, there are more than two titans trapped in the Underworld. No, we haven't specified exactly how many.

claims.summary: More than two titans are trapped in the Underworld; the number is unspecified.
claims.limitation: Design commentary (Making Magic mailbag), not narrative fiction.

remaining: The summary page is the main source; the story-on-cards page, 'Journey's End' and 'Odds & Ends' are targeted, not exhaustive
Elspeth's fate after leaving Theros is not graded here
